output_version: KOMBAX 20124 R73 I18N UNIVERSAL EXPERIENCE FINAL
architectural_decisions: Use native ES-module i18n because the actual frontend is vanilla modular JavaScript, not React; no duplicate i18n library was introduced.
Translation namespaces are semantic and split by domain; Spanish is the master catalog.
Language, country, currency, timezone and jurisdiction remain independent concepts.
Technical routes, QR identifiers and user-created content remain untouched.
Only Spanish is publicly enabled until English passes Phase 6 QA.
Block 2 keeps locale catalogs split into the same 22 namespaces for every language; no monolithic locale file was introduced.
English passed the Block 2 catalog/runtime gate and is now publicly enabled with Spanish.
FR/PT/IT/DE/TH/FIL are fully populated catalogs but remain hidden pending deep product integration and later visual/end-to-end gates.
All UI es-ES literals were replaced by the centralized localeTag(getLocale()) resolver; only the canonical es -> es-ES mapping remains.
Thai uses locale-specific typography/wrapping rules without shrinking global font sizes.
Block 3 propagates user_locale through Assist/Migrations and system notification/document channels without duplicating Luna or other agents.
Generated financial documents keep currency independent from language; locale changes presentation only.
Legal metadata now separates locale, jurisdiction and legal_version; translated legal text is not treated as jurisdictional adaptation.
QR/ticket identifiers remain invariant; only surrounding system UI may localize.
Thai generated finance PDF uses explicit English fallback when the standard embedded PDF font cannot render Thai glyphs, avoiding corrupt output.
All eight locales now use strict 1077-key direct catalogs and are publicly enabled.
FR/PT/IT/DE/TH/FIL now have direct legacy-runtime maps (2580 phrases each) and do not silently use the English legacy-copy table.
Public legal pages have 133 direct strings for every active non-Spanish locale; locale does not alter jurisdiction or legal version.
Supabase Auth templates and PWA manifests explicitly support all eight locales.
Thai dynamic finance PDFs attempt direct Unicode rendering with Noto Sans Thai loaded at runtime and fall back safely if the font cannot be loaded; no font binary is bundled.
User-authored content is now universally translatable as a derived view; the original text remains immutable source of truth and can always be restored with View original.
Public authored content can be prewarmed into all eight locales and cached by source hash; edits invalidate stale translations naturally because source_hash changes.
Private messages/documents remain opt-in and requester-scoped; they are never auto-translated by the public-content preference.
The first onboarding/gateway interface exposes the eight-language selector before club/profile/account choice; the selected locale persists locally and is carried into sign-up preferred_locale.
known_issues: Authenticated/manual visual and end-to-end QA across real identities, desktop/mobile/PWA/Android is still required before production release validation, with special attention to FR/DE long strings and TH rendering.
Android release preflight remains 4/5 because android/keystore.properties is intentionally external to the portable ZIP.
Thai dynamic finance PDF direct Unicode rendering depends on runtime access to the configured Noto Sans Thai font URL; a safe English document fallback remains if the font cannot be loaded.
Prepared Supabase i18n migrations are included but were not automatically deployed; live RLS/RPC behavior must be reviewed in the authorized environment.

Universal authored-content translation requires the kombax-content-translate Edge Function plus OPENAI_API_KEY/KOMBAX_TRANSLATION_MODEL in the authorized deployment environment; automated code QA cannot validate live provider/network behavior.
Universal translation cache migration and Edge Function are included but not automatically deployed; RLS and requester-scoped private translation behavior must be verified in authorized staging.
pending_items: Run authenticated/manual QA for all 8 active locales using representative roles and real navigation paths, including PWA/Android.
Validate real Stripe Checkout/refund, Auth email, push, Assist/Migrations and generated-document flows in authorized staging/production-like environments for each locale.
Validate Thai finance PDF runtime font reachability or configure KOMBAX_THAI_FONT_URL in the deployment environment.
Provide local Android signing configuration and build signed APK/AAB outside the portable ZIP.
Deploy prepared Supabase i18n migrations only through the approved deployment process after live RLS/RPC review.
Deploy and validate the universal translation cache migration and kombax-content-translate Edge Function in authorized staging, including public cache reuse and private requester scoping.
Run authenticated/browser QA from the onboarding language selector through registration and all major authored-content surfaces in all eight locales.
